<a id="bop_invention"></a>
## The Invention in A Minor as Bebop: `bop_invention.yml`

Bop invention: the Two-Part Invention in A minor as bebop. The upper voice of the Invention No. 13,
BWV 784 (Johann Sebastian Bach, 1723) is public domain and is played as written, its sixteenths as
swung eighths at a bebop tempo, read from a transcription in the corpus; the walking bass, the
piano's chords, the answers, the solos and the drums are new.

<a id="the_bucket"></a>
## The Funeral March as a New Orleans Brass Band: `the_bucket.yml`

The bucket: the Funeral March as a New Orleans brass band's funeral. The march theme of the third
movement of the Piano Sonata No. 2 (Frédéric Chopin, 1837) is public domain and is played as written
at a walk, from Claude's knowledge of the score; then the band turns it into the major, which is
this demo's own doing, and dances home. The sousaphone's lines, the saxophones' riffs, the shouts,
the solos and the parade drums are new.
